title: Daily digest: No fine for solo car drivers, no congest | Nara Lokesh asks TDP cadre to step up ef | Polavaram evacuees boycott panchayat pol | Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Puti | Centre empowers states, UTs to use UAPA
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Telangana Today / BBC News / Munsif Daily
bullets_en: No fine for solo car drivers, no congestion penalty proposed: Hyderabad Police.
Nara Lokesh asks TDP cadre to step up efforts for second and third phases of panchayat polls.
Polavaram evacuees boycott panchayat polls in Eluru district, demand separate panchayat.
Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview.
Centre empowers states, UTs to use UAPA against Zakir Naik’s IRF.
bullets_ur: Solo car chalanay walon par koi jurmana nahi, congestion penalty ki bhi tajweez nahi: Hyderabad Police.
Nara Lokesh ki TDP karkunon ko panchayat polls ke dusray aur teesray marhalay ke liye koshishen tez karne ki hidayat.
Eluru district mein Polavaram mutasrin ka panchayat polls ka baikaat, alag panchayat ka mutalba.
Zelensky ki BBC interview mein Trump aur Putin ki 'ajeeb' dosti par tanqeed.
Markazi hukumat ne riyaston aur UTs ko Zakir Naik ki IRF ke khilaf UAPA istemal karne ka ikhtiyar de diya.
